Following its [[Second Battle of Geonosis|second takeover]] of the [[planet]], the [[Galactic Republic]] began its '''second occupation''' of the [[Outer Rim Territories|Outer Rim]] world of [[Geonosis]]. Its successor state, the [[Galactic Empire]], carried on the occupation in the early [[Standard year|years]] of the [[Imperial Era]] until the [[sterilization of Geonosis]].

==Prelude==
{{Quote|We'll have to inform the troops on Geonosis. This parasite might explain how they recaptured the planet the first time. I don't want it happening again.|Jedi General Anakin Skywalker|<ref name="Brain Invaders" />}}
A [[planet]] located in the [[Outer Rim Territories]], [[Geonosis]] was the site of the [[First Battle of Geonosis|opening battle]] of the [[Clone Wars]] between the [[Galactic Republic]] and [[Confederacy of Independent Systems]], yet the Republic's [[Occupation of Geonosis|occupation efforts]] were continually undermined by resistance from the native [[Geonosian]]s.<ref name="Rise" /> Eventually, the Geonosians were able to overcome the Republic and return their services to the Confederacy, resulting in another Republic invasion,<ref name="L@PR">{{TCW|Landing at Point Rain}}</ref> which ended in a Republic victory after [[Standard day|days]] of fighting.<ref name="Brain Invaders" />

Following a [[Skirmish aboard TB-73|skrimish]] involving Geonosian [[brain worm]]s aboard [[Hospital ship|medical frigate]] [[TB-73]], [[Jedi General]] [[Anakin Skywalker]] suspected that the worms had been the key to the Geonosians overthrowing the first Republic occupation. As such, he wanted to make sure the [[clone trooper]]s stationed to maintain the second occupation were told of them.<ref name="Brain Invaders" />

==The occupation==
===Republic occupation===
Focusing its resources on the effort to control the planet, rather than on governance,<ref name="Rise" /> the Republic held on control as the war carried on.<ref name="Catalyst" /> In fact, while some [[Geonosian hive]]s sought to resist their occupiers to emerge as the rulers of Geonosis, others actively helped the Republic in an effort to secure power, whereas some other hives simply went into [[Exile (punishment)|hiding]].<ref name="Rise" /> Meanwhile, Geonosian [[Archduke]] [[Poggle the Lesser]] was held [[prisoner]] by the Republic and questioned over a [[Project Stardust|secret battle station program]] that would one [[Standard day|day]] become the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station|DS-1 Death Star Mobile Battle Station]]. [[Lieutenant Commander]] [[Orson Callan Krennic]] arranged for Poggle to be released as long as he supplied his Geonosian drones as a workforce for the Republic when it began to work on the project. However, Poggle instead used the drones to ensure he could [[Uprising on Geonosis|escape]] Geonosis and return to the CIS.<ref name="Catalyst" />

[[File:Another-Battle-of-Geonosis.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Between 20 BBY and 19 BBY, Republic and Separatist forces again clashed on Geonosis.]]
At some point between [[20 BBY]] and [[19 BBY]],<ref name="20/19 BBY Date note">''[[Star Wars: I Am a Padawan]]'' depicts a battle on [[Geonosis]] in which [[Rex]] is wearing [[phase II clone trooper armor]] and [[Ahsoka Tano]] makes use of her [[Ahsoka Tano's lightsabers|green lightsabers]]. Based on what is presented in ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'', this battle, therefore, must take place between [[20 BBY]] and [[19 BBY]]. Rex does not don [[Phase II clone trooper armor]] during the events of "[[Water War]]" despite it being available but has adopted it by the time of "[[Darkness on Umbara]]," both of which are dated to 20 [['ABY-BBY' dating system|BBY]] by ''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]''. Therefore, Rex equipped himself with Phase II armor in 20 BBY. Further, Tano loses ownership of her green lightsabers during the events of "[[The Wrong Jedi]]," which is dated to [[19 BBY]] according to ''Timelines''. Therefore, the battle must occur between 20 BBY and 19 BBY.</ref> the war again returned to Geonosis, with [[Jedi]] [[General]]s Anakin Skywalker and [[Obi-Wan Kenobi]], [[Jedi Commander]] [[Ahsoka Tano]], and [[Clone Captain]] [[Rex]],<ref name="I Am a Padawan" /> a [[clone trooper officer]] who served under Skywalker and Tano in the elite [[501st Legion]],<ref name="Battlefront II">''[[Star Wars Battlefront II]]''</ref> being deployed to counter [[Confederacy military|Separatist forces]]. As a [[Venator-class Star Destroyer|''Venator''-class Star Destroyer]] and two [[Low Altitude Assault Transport/infantry]] [[gunship]]s flew overhead, [[blaster]] bolts flew across the landscape, while Tano, Skywalker, Kenobi, and Rex were confronted by at least two [[B1-series battle droid]]s, which were both scared by their foes. As Tano chased after them, one of the [[battle droid]]s tried to flee.<ref name="I Am a Padawan" /> In the same timefame,<ref name="20/19 BBY Date note 2">[[Phase II clone trooper armor]] was put into use by the events of "[[Water War]]," which is dated to [[20 BBY]] by ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]''. ''Galactic Atlas'' also dates the [[Mission to Mustafar|end]] of the [[Clone Wars]] to [[19 BBY]]. Because {{Destiny|set=Across the Galaxy|cardname=Attack of the Clones}} depicts a Clone Wars–era engagement on [[Geonosis]] featuring Phase II [[clone trooper armor]], that engagement must occur between those two [[Standard year|years]].</ref> members of<ref name="Attack Card" /> Kenobi's<ref name="Battlefront II" /> [[212th Attack Battalion]] were involved in an attack within the [[Petranaki Arena]],<ref name="Attack Card" /> the same location where the Clone Wars had begun.<ref name="AOTC">{{Film|II}}</ref>

===Imperial rule===
When the Clone Wars ended with the Republic being [[Proclamation of the New Order|transformed]] into the [[Galactic Empire]], the new state continued to hold control over Geonosis, continuing to use the Geonosians as labor to build the Death Star. In fact, as Poggle had been [[Mission to Mustafar|amongst the Separatist leaders killed]] during the end of the war, the Empire was able to take full control over the Geonosians. Despite having been appointed by the [[Unidentified Geonosian queen (Stalgasin hive)|hive queen]], the [[Unidentified Geonosian archduke|newly appointed archduke]] held no true power his own people.<ref name="Catalyst" /> As the construction continued, however, a [[Unidentified Geonosian queen|rogue queen]] in the [[Korakanni Mound]] began to rebel against the Empire's control of Geonosis.<ref name="Annual 2" />

[[File:DeathTroopersExecuteGeonosians-2017DarthVaderAnnual.png|200px|thumb|right|Led by Darth Vader, death troopers helped the Sith Lord wipe out a rogue Geonosian hive.]]
In response, the [[Sith Lord]] [[Darth]] Vader, the [[Sith]] identity of Anakin Skywalker, was dispatched to Geonosis. Eventually uncovering the truth, Vader led a [[squad]] of [[death trooper]]s to the mound, where they confronted the rogue queen and her forces. In the ensuing [[Skirmish in the Korakanni Mound|skirmish]], Vader and his [[trooper]]s slaughtered the rogue Geonosians. Thus, the Death Star was safe to continue construction over Geonosis.<ref name="Annual 2" /> Beyond the Imperial [[technician]]s and Geonosians involved, tens of thousands of [[Slavery|slaves]] were forced to work on the station.<ref name="Dawn" /> In [[14 BBY]],<ref name="Tarkin date">''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates the events of [[Tarkin (novel)|''Tarkin'']] to [[14 BBY]].</ref> the Death Star, finally supplied with operational [[engine]]s, was able to move out of Geonosis's orbit and into deep [[Realspace|space]],<ref name="Tarkin">[[Tarkin (novel)|''Tarkin'']]</ref> yet it returned to the Outer Rim planet to continue construction<ref name="Dawn" /> until around [[9 BBY]].<ref name="Date" /> With [[Saw Gerrera]] of the [[Partisans]] trying to discover what the Empire's major project was,<ref name="Rogue One Visual Guide" /> the Imperials decided to move the [[space station]] to the isolated planet of [[Scarif]]<ref name="Dawn" /> during the final stages of construction.<ref name="Book Manager">{{WebCite|url=https://bookmanager.com/tbm/?q=h.reports.iv&eisbn=jiu6sYIgU6hikaACKYVCLw|text=''Star Wars: Rogue One Mini Build'' preview on Book Manager|archivedate=20200321191931}}</ref>

To keep the Death Star a secret, [[Grand Moff]] [[Wilhuff Tarkin]] gave the order to [[Sterilization of Geonosis|wipe out]] the Geonosians.<ref name="Dawn" /> Using [[Imperial gas canister]]s, the [[Imperial Military]] did so,<ref name="Ghosts of Geonosis">{{Rebels|Ghosts of Geonosis}}</ref> killing one hundred billion beings on Geonosis. The only Geonosian to survive the campaign was a drone later nicknamed [[Klik-Klak]], who protected a surviving queen [[egg]] with the hope his people could return. In reality, the queen was infertile.<ref name="New Ultimate Star Wars">''[[Ultimate Star Wars, New Edition]]''</ref> The sterilization marked the end of the Empire's presence on Geonosis, with the Imperials even trying to remove any sign of their activity. Thus, the only reminders of the occupation were the [[ICM-092792]] construction modules and debris left over the dead planet. Within mere [[Standard month|months]], the Death Star was over Scarif.<ref name="Dawn" />
